articles.title: Crypto PAC notches primary wins, but loses $2M Florida race
articles.snippet: A Fairshake spokesperson said that the PAC was “just getting started“ on its expenditures as part of efforts to fill US Congress with lawmakers friendly to the crypto industry.

articles.title: Injective receives SEC transfer agent registration for institutional services arm
articles.snippet: Injective’s affiliated entity can now maintain securities ownership records, adding regulated market infrastructure to its growing push into tokenized assets.

articles.title: Nearly 2,000 Hacked WordPress Sites Turned Into Criminal Infrastructure
articles.snippet: The StopAndProtect operation used compromised WordPress websites to spread malware, steal crypto wallet files, and deploy ransomware.
